description: This script is a start-up script for the ProtocolandCodingService project that installs dependencies, sets environment variables, and manages the lifecycle of a uvicorn server process, including signal handling.

methods.name: _term
methods.description: Handles SIGTERM signal to gracefully terminate the uvicorn server.

methods.name: _int
methods.description: Handles SIGINT signal to gracefully terminate the uvicorn server.
